## Terms

### Atlas Live Migration

- **Atlas Live Migration** · self — Atlas Live Migration is a managed Mongosync workflow: it copies source data, continuously applies later source changes, and leaves applications using the source until cutover. AWS Prescriptive Guidance independently describes the same initial-copy, change-monitoring, and cutover sequence. (high conf — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/live-migration.md
